meta.title: Fulus — Where your circle invests
meta.description: Fulus is the app for families and friends in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf who invest together — pooled contributions, recorded votes, exact ownership, clean settlements. Private beta, now onboarding.
a11y.hero.alt: The Fulus club dashboard seen through the Fulus portal — Noor Family Club, balances and a live vote

hero.head: Where your circle invests.
hero.sub: Fulus runs the money side for families and friends who invest together in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

problem.head: Someone always carries the books.
problem.p1: Every group has one: the member who owns the spreadsheet, chases the transfers, and stays up reconciling other people’s money.
problem.p2: Votes happen in WhatsApp and evaporate. Numbers live in one person’s head. Trust does all the accounting — until it can’t.
problem.alt: A lone silhouette figure surrounded by drifting spreadsheet fragments
product.head: The product, shown.
product.sub: Real screens from the Fulus beta — this is the app your club gets today.
product.ch1.head: Pool the money, without the chasing.
product.ch1.body: Every member’s contribution lands in one shared record — who paid, when, and the receipt to prove it. No more screenshots forwarded three times.
product.ch1.alt: Fulus beta screen showing a club’s pooled contributions
product.ch2.head: Decide together, on the record.
product.ch2.body: Proposals get a card, members get a vote, and the outcome is stored where everyone can see it — not buried in a group chat.
product.ch2.alt: Fulus beta screen showing a club vote in progress
product.ch3.head: Every share, exact.
product.ch3.body: Fulus computes each member’s ownership from their actual contributions, every cycle. No estimates, no awkward conversations.
product.ch3.alt: Fulus beta screen showing per-member ownership
product.ch4.head: Settle a cycle in minutes.
product.ch4.body: Close the cycle and Fulus works out each member’s share of the results — pro-rata, auditable, done before the tea gets cold.
product.ch4.alt: Fulus beta screen showing a cycle settlement summary
how.head: How it works
how.s1.head: Create your club
how.s1.body: Name it, set the ground rules, and open the books in minutes.
how.s2.head: Invite your circle
how.s2.body: Members join with a link — family, friends, colleagues you already trust.
how.s3.head: Invest and settle together
how.s3.body: Contribute, vote, and let Fulus keep every share exact through each cycle.
how.alt: Silhouette figures walking together toward a glowing Fulus portal
trust.head: Trust, plainly.
trust.note: I built Fulus because I was the one carrying my club’s books. Fulus is what I wished we had: one honest record that every member can see. We’re a small team in Saudi Arabia, we’re in private beta, and the clubs that join now shape what we build next.
trust.name: Ahmed — founder of Fulus
trust.security: Your data is encrypted. We never share your email.
trust.beta: Fulus is in private beta. Early clubs get direct access to the team — and shape the product.
vision.head: Built for the future. Available today.
vision.body: We are building toward a treasury every member can verify for themselves — the same shared record, provable rather than promised. What you join today is the working product; the road ahead only deepens it.
cta.head: Your invite is on the other side.
cta.next: Invites go out in waves. Your email gets launch updates — nothing else.
footer.disclosure: Fulus is in private beta. Waitlist emails are stored with Fulus and never shared.

privacy.title: Privacy — Fulus
privacy.head: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page covers the fulus.sa waitlist. Plain language, short on purpose.
privacy.store.head: What we store
privacy.store.body: Your email address, your language preference, and — if you answer the optional questions — whether you have a club and how big it is. That’s the whole list.
privacy.why.head: Why we store it
privacy.why.body: To hold your place in line, to send you launch updates, and to invite you when your wave opens. Your email is never sold or shared with anyone.
privacy.removal.head: Want off the list?
privacy.removal.body: Send an email from the address you signed up with and we’ll delete your record. Reach us at
privacy.pdpl: We handle this data in line with the principles of Saudi Arabia’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
